name: partners-section-v3
title: Partners Section v3
description: Partners section for a social scheduling app: a two-column grid of large network names with icons (Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, Reddit, Bluesky, Telegram, Slack). GSAP brightens the heading word by word on scroll and fades the partners up in reading order.

"use client" import { useRef } from "react" import PartnerItem from "./partner-item" import { usePartnersV3Motion } from "../hooks/use-partners-v3-motion" import { partnersSectionV3Content } from "../lib/config" import { partners } from "../lib/partners" export default function PartnersSectionV3() { const { heading, description } = partnersSectionV3Content const sectionRef = useRef(null) usePartnersV3Motion(sectionRef) const words = heading.split(" ") return (

{words.map((word, i) => ( {word} {i < words.length - 1 ? " " : null} ))}

{description}

    {partners.map((partner) => ( ))}
) }
